# AutoFillPDF - Complete Documentation

> AutoFillPDF is an online tool that converts any PDF form (including scanned, non-fillable, or image-based PDFs) into a clean web form, allows users to fill it digitally with optional autofill from saved profiles, add signatures, and download a completed PDF with answers overlaid on the original document.

---

## About AutoFillPDF

AutoFillPDF solves a common frustration: dealing with PDF forms that require printing, handwriting, and scanning. Many PDF forms are not digitally fillable, especially scanned documents, government forms, or older paperwork.

AutoFillPDF uses OCR (Optical Character Recognition) technology to read any PDF - even scanned or image-based documents - and converts them into clean, easy-to-use web forms. Users fill out the form in their browser, add a digital signature, and download a completed PDF with their answers perfectly placed on the original document.

---

## Key Features

### Works with Any PDF
- Scanned documents
- Photos of paper forms
- Non-fillable PDFs
- Image-based forms
- Older PDF formats

### Smart Form Detection
- OCR-powered field detection
- Automatic field type recognition (text, date, checkbox, signature)
- Quality scoring to indicate confidence level
- Manual field adjustment when needed

### Digital Signature
- Built-in signature pad
- Draw signature with mouse or touch
- Signature saved for future forms (Pro users)

### Autofill Profiles (Pro Feature)
- Save common information (name, address, SSN, etc.)
- One-click autofill on any form
- Multiple profiles for different contexts
- Smart field matching

### Security & Privacy
- 256-bit SSL encryption
- Files stored securely in cloud storage
- Automatic deletion: 72 hours (guests), 180 days (Pro users)
- No data selling or sharing
- GDPR compliant

## How to Use AutoFillPDF

### Step 1: Upload Your PDF
1. Go to https://autofilllpdf.com/upload
2. Drag and drop your PDF or click to browse
3. Wait for OCR processing (usually 10-30 seconds)
4. Review the detected fields

### Step 2: Fill the Form
1. The system displays a clean web form based on detected fields
2. Fill in your information in each field
3. Use autofill (Pro) to populate common fields automatically
4. Add your signature using the signature pad

### Step 3: Download Your PDF
1. Review your completed form
2. Complete payment if required (guests: $5, subscribers: use included forms)
3. Download your completed PDF
4. Submit to wherever needed (email, upload, print)

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Does it work with scanned PDFs?
Yes! AutoFillPDF uses OCR technology to read scanned documents, photos of forms, and image-based PDFs. Just upload any PDF and the system will convert it to a fillable form.

### Is my data secure?
Yes. AutoFillPDF uses 256-bit SSL encryption for all data transfers. Guest files are automatically deleted after 72 hours, and Pro user files after 180 days. We never sell or share your data.

### Can I cancel anytime?
Yes. You can cancel your subscription anytime from your dashboard. Your access continues until the end of the current billing period.

### What if I need more forms than my plan includes?
You can purchase extra forms at discounted rates: $2/form for Starter and Pro plans, $1.50/form for Enterprise.

### How does autofill work?
Save your information (name, address, etc.) in a profile. When you upload a new form, click 'Autofill' and AutoFillPDF automatically matches and fills the fields. Pro users can save multiple profiles for different contexts (personal, work, etc.).

### What file formats are supported?
AutoFillPDF works with PDF files. If you have a form in another format (Word, image), convert it to PDF first, then upload.

### What if the OCR misses a field?
You can manually add or edit fields using the built-in field editor. The system shows confidence scores so you know which fields may need adjustment.

### Is there a refund policy?
Yes. AutoFillPDF offers a 30-day satisfaction guarantee. If you're not satisfied, contact support for a full refund.
